name: public_education_effort
genetic_identity: Public education effort is the scale of government resource commitment to education as a share of economic output and/or public budgets — an input/priority measure, not a learning or completion outcome.
description: Concept for measuring how much of the public purse and economy is allocated to education. Success under this concept is not the same as success under secondary completion. Primary bindings: SE.XPD.TOTL.GD.ZS and SE.XPD.TOTL.GB.ZS.

atoms.name: is_resource_commitment
atoms.statement: Public education effort is a measure of government resource commitment to education, not of student outcomes.

atoms.name: has_gdp_share_face
atoms.statement: One face of effort is government education expenditure as a percentage of GDP (WDI SE.XPD.TOTL.GD.ZS).

atoms.name: has_budget_share_face
atoms.statement: Another face of effort is government education expenditure as a percentage of total government expenditure (WDI SE.XPD.TOTL.GB.ZS).

atoms.name: is_country_year_evaluable
atoms.statement: Effort is evaluable for a country-year when at least one of the two expenditure shares is non-null.

atoms.name: success_is_not_completion
atoms.statement: High public education effort does not by itself entail high secondary completion; those are separate concepts.

atoms.name: is_independent_of_enrollment_levels
atoms.statement: Effort is independent of enrollment rates; large systems and small systems can show similar expenditure shares.

rules.name: must_not_treat_effort_as_outcome
rules.statement: Treating high spend % GDP as proof of educational outcome success leaves this concept and invents an outcome concept without warrant.

rules.name: must_not_use_total_gov_expense_alone
rules.statement: General government expense % GDP (GC.XPN.TOTL.GD.ZS) without education share is not public education effort.

rules.name: null_not_low_effort
rules.statement: Missing expenditure observations are outside the evaluable envelope, not scored as zero effort.

includes: Country-year instances with at least one non-null education expenditure share.
excludes: Secondary or tertiary enrollment as effort.
Private household education spending (not in this panel).

breaks_at: Private spending dominance without public series
Outcome claims derived only from spend

glossary.effort: Public resource commitment to education as share of GDP and/or government budget.
glossary.expenditure_share: Education spending as a percentage of a stated aggregate (GDP or total government expenditure).

exemplars.name: high_spend_low_completion
exemplars.description: A country-year with education % GDP above threshold and completion below threshold proves the two concepts can diverge — both may be correctly evaluated on the same panel.
